util

Class ConsoleBar

  • java.lang.Object
    • util.ConsoleBar

  • public final class ConsoleBar
extends java.lang.Object
    A lightweight console utility for rendering a real-time progress bar.

    This utility uses the carriage return (\r) character to update a single line in the console, providing a dynamic visual representation of task completion without flooding the standard output with new lines.

    Since:

    • Method Detail

      • updateProgressBar

        public static void updateProgressBar(int current,
                                     int total)
        Updates the console progress bar based on the provided progress ratio.

        The bar is fixed at 50 characters wide. When current reaches total, a line separator is automatically appended to finalise the output.

        Parameters:
        current - the current completion count
        total - the target total count
